children: Peter Li, currently Global President of HEXPOL Wheels, has been appointed President HEXPOL China and new member of Group Management, effective January 1, 2027.

HEXPOL China is a new organizational unit that will consolidate the Group’s Chinese operations within Rubber Compounding, Thermoplastic Compounding, and Wheels under a unified leadership. The reorganization aims to strengthen coordination and increase strategic focus on the Chinese market.
Peter Li joined HEXPOL in 2008 and, in his current role as global President of HEXPOL Wheels, has successfully driven profitable growth alongside his team, both in China and globally.

“Chinese customers and suppliers are vital to HEXPOL’s continued success. Through this change, we will increase our focus on the Chinese market while strengthening global collaboration in both sales and raw material sourcing. I really look forward to welcoming Peter Li to HEXPOL’s Group Management,” says Henrik Elmin, President and CEO of HEXPOL.
The organizational change will not affect HEXPOL’s financial segments or external reporting structure.

HEXPOL is a world-leading polymers group with strong global positions in advanced polymer compounds (Compounding), gaskets for plate heat exchangers (Gaskets and Seals), and wheels made of polymer materials for truck and castor wheel applications (Wheels). Customers are primarily system suppliers to the global automotive and engineering industry, building and construction industry and within sectors as transportation, energy, consumer and cable industry and manufacturers of medical equipment, plate heat exchangers and forklifts.
The Group is organized in three business areas - HEXPOL Compounding, HEXPOL Thermoplastic Compounding and HEXPOL Engineered Products.
The HEXPOL Group’s sales in 2025 amounted to 19,324 MSEK and the Group has approximately 5,000 employees in fourteen countries.
Further information is available at www.hexpol.com.
